outgoing.name: 19th century
outgoing.excerpt: As was true in many US cities at the end of the 19th century, cable cars briefly ran down D.C. streets.

outgoing.name: Electricity
outgoing.excerpt: This extension was built as an electric line, and in 1899, the rest of the cable car line was converted to electricity.
